description_en: Queries the configuration of an address based on the specified input parameters
description_zh: 根据传入参数获取地址配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-cloud-gtm-address --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --address-id addr-895182181143680000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCloudGtmAddress

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese

en-US (default): English
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果显示的语言。取值：

zh-CN：中文

en-US（默认值）：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。注意  由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the address
parameters.name: address_id
